draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Glad to hear things are going well and that nothing's felt like a blocker so far — thanks for the reply.

One thing that tends to make the layout click: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place usually makes the rest fall into place. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like a guided path.

Would a 15-minute call this week work? I'm happy to walk through setting up your first project with you and answer anything about the layout as we go.

Best,
Chidi
